_note: Lines for the festival events (data/events/festival_*.json, data/festivals.json): one part per festival, from its id. All our own.

lines.text: Pink petals drift over the road. Mats are spread under the cherry trees, and a stall is selling sweet dango.

lines.speaker: tsuru
lines.text: You came! Blossom Day only lasts as long as the petals do. Sit down, eat something, rest your hands.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: The whole village is out under the trees today.
Red lanterns hang along the road, glowing in the dusk. A drum thumps from the little stage.

lines.speaker: tsuru
lines.text: Lantern Night! Try the stalls, and when it's fully dark, look up. The fireworks start after half past seven.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Fireworks, out here? I'll stay for those.
Pampas grass stands in tall vases by the shrine, and a little pile of white dango waits for the moon.

lines.speaker: tsuru
lines.text: On Moon Night we only sit and look up. A good harvest has earned a quiet evening.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: It's so bright tonight. I can see every roof tile.
A fire crackles in the shrine yard. Bamboo and pine stand by the torii, ready for the new year.

lines.speaker: tsuru
lines.text: One more year done. Make a wish at the shrine, then come and warm your hands by the fire.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: My first year here... it went by fast.
